name: br.com.mrocigno.bigbrother.report.ui.SessionDetailsActivity
description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. After a user selects a saved session in BigBrother, this screen shows its recorded activity and links to the session's network and log details.
disableEffect: Saved session details and their diagnostic links will not be viewable in BigBrother; the app's normal screens are unaffected.
